ammonia.reason: Moderate deamination of amino acids during 7-10 month aging.

animal_barnyard.reason: Trace p-cresol/indole, pasteurized cow milk and clean brine aging limit barnyard.

bitter.reason: Accumulation of hydrophobic bitter peptides, partially balanced by salt and sweetness.

blue_moldy.reason: Low methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone from background fat oxidation, no blue mold.

browning.reason: Concentrated free amino acids and residual galactose drive Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Residual diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism, partly lost in aging.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate lipolysis releasing butanoic, hexanoic and 3-methylbutanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: High fat but low moisture and crystalline texture reduce creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Dry proteolyzed matrix with tyrosine/calcium lactate crystals fractures easily.

firmness.reason: Low ~32% moisture and dense pressed paste plus Ca-paracaseinate crosslinking after aging.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol during aging.

goaty.reason: Very low caproic/caprylic branched goaty acids in pasteurized cow milk, no goat milk.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes 2-/3-methylbutanal and roasted notes from extended proteolysis and drying.

melt.reason: Aged low-moisture lower-pH network flows poorly versus young Monterey Jack.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free oil release from coalesced fat in aged low-moisture matrix when heated.

smoky.reason: No smoke applied, only trace guaiacol and pepper-cocoa rind dust.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic and acetic acids from starter fermentation, mellowed by washing and aging.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet gel with no hot-water alignment, no stretch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methionine-derived methanethiol/dimethyl sulfide, no high-heat cook.

sweet.reason: Glycerol, proline and caramel lactones like delta-decalactone from long aging.

umami.reason: High free glutamate and savory peptides from prolonged rennet/plasmin proteolysis.
